statement.p: Find the volume of the region bounded by z=x^2, 0 \le x \le 4, and the planes y=0, y=7, and z=0.

static.solution: V, is given by V = \int_0^{4} \int_0^{7} \int_{0}^{x^2} \,dz \,dy \,dx = \int_0^{4} \int_0^{7} x^2 \,dy\,dx. Integration in y is easy, giving V = \int_0^{4} x^2 y\bigg|_{y=0}^{y=7}\, dx = \int_0^{4} 7 x^2\,dx. Then, integrating with respect to x, we have V = \frac{7}{3}\,x^3\bigg|_{x=0}^{x=4} = \frac{448}{3}.
